0715Mechanics and metal trades

FreeCAD computer-use environment (REA)

earakely-scale/FreeCADComputerEnv-REA

In FreeCAD, cut a 10 mm hole through the middle of a plate using menus and property editors only, then save.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • desktop computer-use evaluation
  • GUI-only editing task
  • long-ish GUI action sequences

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Pass or fail

A verifier script reads the app's saved files through a data view and passes only if every check holds, with no model.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

hf download earakely-scale/FreeCADComputerEnv-REA --repo-type dataset --local-dir freecad
agent-env run freecad/bundle --task add-hole-gui --agent claude-code --model <model>

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download earakely-scale/FreeCADComputerEnv-REA --repo-type dataset --local-dir FreeCADComputerEnv-REA

Needs: Docker.

Evidence

5 of 5 Claude Code runs passed and a scripted witness run shows the task is doable through the GUI.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
